exact.全連線每個輸出連到全部輸入，權重數為 $\\mathcal{O}(m\\time: In a fully connected layer every output connects to all inputs, so there are $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$ weights; in a convolution every output connects only to a local region of size $k$, so there are $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$ weights.

exact.參數共享意味著同一組核權重在整張影像的不同空間位置重複利用，無需為每個座標各學一: Parameter sharing means the same set of kernel weights is reused at different spatial positions across the whole image, so there is no need to learn a separate set for every coordinate.

b9b14ed52b53.zh: 稀疏連線與參數共享 Sparse Connectivity and Parameter Sharing

66a506b0eaaf.zh: 全連線網路讓每一對輸入與輸出「人人握手」，參數量高達 $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$。卷積神經網路藉由稀疏連線（每輸出僅看 $k$ 個鄰居）與參數共享（全圖共用同一組濾波器），將參數量陡降至 $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$。這不是魔法，而是以空間局部性先驗換取的極致算力節省。
66a506b0eaaf.en: A fully connected network makes every input–output pair “shake hands”, with up to $\mathcal{O}(m\times n)$ parameters. Convolutional neural networks use sparse connectivity (each output looks at only $k$ neighbors) and parameter sharing (the whole image shares the same set of filters) to cut the parameter count sharply to $\mathcal{O}(k\times n)$. This is not magic: it is an extreme saving of compute bought with a spatial-locality prior.

cf2acfa8a9c8.zh:
「每人一條專線 vs 同一把尺量全圖」 全連線讓每個位置獨立建立連線；卷積用一把小尺在全圖巡迴蓋印！
Dense wires everyone to everyone; CNN shares local rulers across space.
cf2acfa8a9c8.en:
“A private line for everyone vs one ruler measuring the whole image”
      <small>Full connectivity gives every position its own independent connections; convolution takes one small ruler on a stamping tour of the whole image!</small>

8ec077328faf.zh: 稀疏連線（Sparse Connectivity）：每個單元只看鄰居 Sparse Connectivity: Local Receptive Fields Instead of Global Dense Wiring
8ec077328faf.en: Sparse connectivity: each unit looks only at its neighbors

a2c2f1135aab.zh: 為什麼不需要「人人連線」？
a2c2f1135aab.en: Why don't we need “everyone connected to everyone”?

2f3702a788f1.zh: 在標準全連線網路中，若輸入有 $m$ 個畫素、輸出隱藏層有 $n$ 個神經元，權重矩陣包含 $m\times n$ 個獨立數值，每個輸出神經元都與 $m$ 個輸入相連。
2f3702a788f1.en: In a standard fully connected network, if the input has $m$ pixels and the hidden output layer has $n$ neurons, the weight matrix contains $m\times n$ independent values, and every output neuron is connected to all $m$ inputs.

0349adde2075.zh: 然而自然影像具備強烈的局部統計相關性：左上角的一枚畫素只與其周圍相鄰畫素息息相關，而與右下角 200 畫素外的背景互不干擾。卷積層限制每個輸出單元僅連線至大小為 $k$（例如 $3\times 3=9$）的局部感受野（receptive field），切斷所有冗餘的遠端連線。
0349adde2075.en: But natural images have strong local statistical correlation: a pixel in the top-left corner is closely related only to the pixels around it, and has nothing to do with the background 200 pixels away in the bottom-right corner. A convolutional layer restricts each output unit to a local receptive field of size $k$ (e.g. $3\times 3=9$), cutting all the redundant long-range connections.

e80224a1f436.zh: 參數共享（Parameter Sharing）：全圖同一套權重 Parameter Sharing: Reusing Weights Across the Entire Spatial Grid
e80224a1f436.en: Parameter sharing: one set of weights for the whole image

e5c5026f970c.en: 🚫 The isolated weights of a fully connected layer

8d4a7df4adf6.zh: 全連線權重矩陣中的每一個元素 $w_{ij}$，一生只被使用一次——專門用來計算輸入第 $j$ 個節點與輸出第 $i$ 個節點的乘積。換了空間位置，就得重新學一套全新的獨立權重。
8d4a7df4adf6.en: Each element $w_{ij}$ of a fully connected weight matrix is used only once in its lifetime: solely to compute the product between input node $j$ and output node $i$. At a different spatial position, a whole new set of independent weights has to be learned.

332182c2fe24.en: ♻️ The ultimate reuse of a convolutional layer

90bfd118c1e9.zh: 卷積核的 $k$ 個參數，在特徵圖的每一個空間位置都被重複使用！在左上角辨識水平邊緣的濾波器，滑動到右上角或中央時，仍然使用完全相同的這組權重。
90bfd118c1e9.en: The $k$ parameters of a convolution kernel are reused at every spatial position of the feature map! The filter that recognizes horizontal edges in the top-left corner still uses exactly the same set of weights when it slides to the top-right corner or the center.

132744002a8e.en: Then every output node again sees all input nodes, and the convolutional layer mathematically degenerates back into a fully connected layer.

d1c81e6b8c30.zh: 只有當 k ≪ m（如 3×3 核掃描 224×224 影像）時，稀疏與共享的威力才能最大化釋放。

c2bf106e8056.zh: 只稀疏、不共享：稱為 Locally Connected Layer（局部連線層）。每個局部位置依然擁有獨立權重，參數量仍遠高於卷積。
c2bf106e8056.en: Sparse but not shared: this is called a locally connected layer. Each local position still has its own independent weights, so the parameter count is still far higher than a convolution's.

487ff5bf5643.zh: 只共享、不稀疏：如果核與全圖一樣大，那隻不過是拿一個巨大的全連線矩陣對全圖做一次性運算。
487ff5bf5643.en: Shared but not sparse: if the kernel is as large as the whole image, it is nothing more than applying one huge fully connected matrix to the whole image in a single operation.

ea1dc4ee4ca7.zh: 稀疏 ＋ 共享：雙劍合璧，才成就了 CNN 的輕量與平移等變性！
ea1dc4ee4ca7.en: Sparse + shared: only the two swords combined give the CNN its light weight and translation equivariance!

213d324e9d07.en: 💬 A favorite trick question on exams

017ef2c71e2f.zh:
問：卷積層在什麼情況下會實質上退化為全連線層？
答：當卷積核尺寸 $k$ 等於輸入影像尺寸 $m$ 時。此時每個輸出單元都「看見」了全圖所有輸入，稀疏性歸零；又因為核尺寸與輸入相同，核無法在影像上滑動（只能蓋印一次），參數共享亦失去意義，數學形式與全連線矩陣完全一致。
017ef2c71e2f.en:
Q: Under what condition does a convolutional layer effectively degenerate into a fully connected layer?
A: When the kernel size $k$ equals the input image size $m$. Then every output unit “sees” all the inputs of the whole image, and the sparsity drops to zero; and since the kernel is the same size as the input, it cannot slide over the image (it can only stamp once), so parameter sharing loses its meaning too, and the mathematical form is exactly that of a fully connected matrix.

e0ea4fa6d5ec.zh: 卷積神經網路中的「參數共享（Parameter Sharing）」確切是指？
e0ea4fa6d5ec.en: What exactly does “parameter sharing” mean in a convolutional neural network?

3b6df699bab1.zh: A. 每個空間位置獨立學習一套專屬的 kernel 權重
3b6df699bab1.en: A. Each spatial position independently learns its own set of kernel weights

6257b34464f4.zh: B. 同一顆 kernel 在輸入特徵圖的所有空間位置重複滑動套用
6257b34464f4.en: B. The same kernel slides over and is applied at every spatial position of the input feature map

48e865bd1f33.zh: C. 輸入通道與輸出通道強制共用同一組啟用函式

242ae626efe8.zh: A. 在每個空間位置都被重複使用多次
